summary: AquaBattery is the world's most sustainable long duration energy storage solution based on saltwater., founded in 2014. Type: listed company. About 25 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Climate-tech startup of about 25 people storing renewable power in saltwater; IND recognised sponsor with a multicultural team and no-Dutch roles.

culture.text: About 25 people in Alphen aan den Rijn, building a long-duration battery that stores electricity using water and table salt.
A multicultural team of R&D experts and business developers, led by co-founders; CEO holds a PhD from Imperial College London.
Staff come mostly from TU Delft, Wageningen, VU Amsterdam and Groningen, in chemical engineering and chemistry.
Says it does not hire for remote positions.

open.text: AquaBattery is an IND recognised visa sponsor.

growth.text: Founded in 2014 and still small at 11-50 staff; it has built four pilot systems so far.

worth_knowing.text: Won the 2025 European Sustainable Energy Award.
Warns it will never ask for sensitive data or payments during hiring, so treat such requests as scams.
